Priya Raman
Senior Backend Engineer | Hyderabad, Telangana, India | priya.raman.test@example.com | +91 98765 43210
linkedin.com/in/priya-raman-test | github.com/priyaraman-test | priyaraman.dev

Summary
Backend engineer with 6 years of experience building distributed systems in Go and Python. Led the migration of a
payments platform to event-driven microservices on AWS (Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes), cutting p99 latency by
40%. Comfortable owning services end to end: design, on-call, observability and mentoring.
Experience
Senior Software Engineer, Ledgerline Fintech, Hyderabad - Mar 2023 to present
- Designed a Go settlement service processing 3M transactions/day on Kafka and PostgreSQL.
- Introduced OpenTelemetry tracing and SLOs; reduced incident time-to-resolve from 90 to 25 minutes.
- Mentored 4 engineers; ran the backend interview loop.
Software Engineer, Cartwheel Commerce, Bengaluru - Jul 2020 to Feb 2023
- Built Python (FastAPI) order and inventory APIs serving 2,000 requests/s.
- Moved batch jobs to Kubernetes CronJobs and Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure.
Associate Software Engineer, Brightpath Labs, Pune - Jun 2019 to Jun 2020
- Java/Spring REST services and PostgreSQL schema design for a logistics product.
Skills
Go, Python, Java, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, gRPC, REST, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS (ECS, RDS, SQS,
Lambda), OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
Education
B.Tech, Computer Science and Engineering - National Institute of Technology, Warangal - 2015 to 2019 (CGPA 8.6/10)
Other
Work authorization: Indian citizen; no sponsorship needed to work in India. Notice period: 30 days. Open to hybrid roles
in Hyderabad or remote. Expected salary: INR 42 LPA. Languages: English, Telugu, Hindi.
